target_game: Project Zomboid Build 42. See each mod's branch and compatibility range.
scope: 61 registered individual patches. See publishing/workshop.json for the verified collection release and per-patch guides for rebuilding and dependencies.

mods.title_zh: 洗衣皂中文文本修复
mods.description_original: Corrects the washing soap Chinese label that causes missing-format-argument warnings. Obsolete ammo recipe translation overrides have been retired. Translation only.
mods.summary_zh: 目前仅修复洗衣皂中文名称的格式参数警告；旧弹药配方覆盖已退役。历史文件夹名保留以免破坏ID。
mods.summary_en: Currently fixes the Chinese washing-soap label and missing-format-argument warnings. Old ammo-recipe overrides are retired; the historical folder/ID is preserved.

excluded_files.reason: documentation/history/personal configuration; not a runtime source

mods.title_zh: 挂点物品分组与穿戴菜单修复
mods.title_en: Attached Item Grouping and Wear Menu Fix
mods.description_original: Refreshes inventory grouping after hotbar changes and limits Wear actions to wearable items. Preserves attachment slots, item properties, inventory selection and the normal equipped-items section.
mods.summary_zh: 挂点变化后刷新库存分组，并把穿戴操作限于真正可穿戴物品；不改挂点或物品属性。
mods.summary_en: Refreshes inventory grouping after attachment changes and limits Wear actions to wearable items. Attachment slots and item properties are retained.

mods.title_zh: 房车手套箱容器兼容
mods.description_original: Private compatibility patch for Campers. Adds the native GloveBox container to six camper scripts. Load after KI5campers. Original interior models, parts, and callbacks are retained.
mods.summary_zh: 为六种KI5房车车辆脚本补原生GloveBox容器。第三方整份车辆脚本不直接入库；从已安装42.20来源应用六份上下文差异重建42.21覆盖。
mods.summary_en: Adds the native GloveBox container to six KI5 camper scripts. Full third-party vehicle scripts are not stored here; six context diffs reconstruct the 42.21 overlays from pinned installed 42.20 sources.

mods.title_zh: 中华菜与N&C种子提示兼容
mods.title_en: Chinese Cuisine and N&C Seed Tooltips
mods.description_original: Display compatibility for Chinesecuisine and N&C seed packets in More Item Information. Does not change learned recipes or planting rules.
mods.summary_zh: 在More Item Information中显示中华菜与N&C种子的已知季节和农耕数据；不改学习配方或种植规则。
mods.summary_en: Shows learned seasons and farming data for Chinese Cuisine and N&C seed packets in More Item Information, without changing learned recipes or planting rules.

mods.title_zh: Fashionoid储液提示兼容
mods.description_original: Allows Fashionoid to skip non-item tooltip objects that lack the item type method. Normal item eligibility remains delegated to Fashionoid. Review after Fashionoid updates.
mods.summary_zh: 让Fashionoid跳过缺少物品类型方法的非物品储液提示对象，其余判定仍交给Fashionoid。
mods.summary_en: Lets Fashionoid skip non-item fluid tooltip objects without the item-type method. Normal eligibility is still delegated to Fashionoid.

mods.title_zh: MFS瞄具标签修复
mods.description_original: Corrects audited non-sight attachments incorrectly tagged as optics. Keeps weapon parts and actual scopes intact.
mods.summary_zh: 纠正已审计非瞄具配件上错误的optics标签，保留真正瞄具及枪械配件。
mods.summary_en: Corrects optics tags on audited non-sight accessories while preserving real scopes and weapon parts.

mods.title_zh: Mustang引擎盖配方输入保护
mods.description_original: Restricts the Mustang hood cutting input to its three intended vehicle hood items. Original materials, tools, skills and outputs remain unchanged.
mods.summary_zh: 把Mustang引擎盖切割配方输入限制为预期三种引擎盖；不改工具、技能、材料和产物。
mods.summary_en: Restricts the Mustang hood-cutting recipe to the three intended hood items, preserving tools, skills, other materials and outputs.

mods.title_zh: N&C药物状态面板
mods.description_original: 右键 N&C 药物查看过量、成瘾、药效、戒断与混用状态。
mods.summary_zh: 右键查看过量累计、成瘾预警、当前药效、戒断和混用状态。
mods.summary_en: Read-only context panel for overdose, addiction, active effects, withdrawal and interactions.

excluded_files.reason: documentation/history/personal configuration; not a runtime source

mods.title_zh: 针剂减重与肾上腺素笔兼容
mods.description_original: 塔科夫针剂重量调整、肾上腺素笔汉化与针剂盒兼容；肾上腺素药效240游戏分钟。
mods.summary_zh: 13种成品CombatStims针剂及Adrenapen默认重量0.05、空针筒0.03，并增加针剂盒兼容、肾上腺素笔汉化及240游戏分钟药效。保留已有自定义重量和过量机制；这是含玩法调整的补丁。
mods.summary_en: Sets default weight of 13 finished CombatStims injectors and Adrenapen to 0.05 and empty syringes to 0.03, adds case compatibility/localization and a 240-game-minute adrenaline duration. Existing custom weights and overdose rules stay. This includes gameplay changes.

mods.title_zh: 旧普通容器桥接与HavenFall EX兼容
mods.title_en: 蘇清容器升级：针剂盒与新增衣物兼容 [B42.21–42.22]
mods.description_original: B42.21–42.22 单人。配合超级升级 1.0.0-rc.3 保留 HavenFall 背包既有 EX 容量和还原。使用原生进阶前须先还原蘇清升级。保留对旧普通升级 1.0.0 的原有桥接。 / B42.21–42.22 single-player. With Backpack EX 1.0.0-rc.3, preserves existing HavenFall EX capacity and restoration. Restore SuQing upgrades before native tier crafting. Includes the legacy ordinary 1.0.0 compatibility layer.
mods.summary_zh: 旧普通1.0.0的四个物品接入与HavenFall EX桥接。普通发布1.0.1已内置四ID；该版本下旧普通adapter整体拒绝接入，HavenFall EX独立脚本仍按EX rc.2版本验证工作。
mods.summary_en: B42.21–42.22 单人。配合超级升级 1.0.0-rc.3 保留 HavenFall 背包既有 EX 容量和还原。使用原生进阶前须先还原蘇清升级。保留对旧普通升级 1.0.0 的原有桥接。 / B42.21–42.22 single-player. With Backpack EX 1.0.0-rc.3, preserves existing HavenFall EX capacity and restoration. Restore SuQing upgrades before native tier crafting. Includes the legacy ordinary 1.0.0 compatibility layer.

mods.title_zh: XFACTION进度记录保护
mods.description_original: Preserves a bound single-player XFACTION progress record during transient survival-time drops, while separating confirmed deaths and new character identities.
mods.summary_zh: 保护单人人物在生存时间短暂下降时已绑定的XFACTION进度记录，区分确认死亡和新人身份；不把旧人物记录复制给新人。
mods.summary_en: Protects a bound single-player XFACTION progress record during transient survival-time drops, distinguishing confirmed death and new identities instead of copying old progress to a new character.

mods.title_zh: Chemical独立兼容构建
mods.description_original: 独立生化套装，与 Fantasy 的原战术套装分别保留。保持原版 C.B.R.T. Chemical 关闭。
mods.summary_zh: 把Chemical装备放到独立CodexCBRT命名空间，与幻想工坊原套装分别保留。26份模型/PNG素材来自原作者，仅按映射从本机原件重建；Git不收这些素材。使用说明要求原CBRT模组保持关闭，但本工具不会替用户改启用列表。
mods.summary_en: Places Chemical equipment in the independent CodexCBRT namespace, separate from the Fantasy Workshop set. Twenty-six model/PNG files belong to the upstream author and are reconstructed only from local originals. They are absent from Git. The original build instructions keep the original CBRT mod disabled; this tool never changes enabled lists.

mods.title_zh: 人物菜单调整
mods.description_original: Moves the existing XFACTION progress entry into character information. Presentation-only, no progression or item changes.
mods.summary_zh: 将现有XFACTION进度入口移动到人物信息；调整浣熊市人物菜单呈现，不改进度或物品。
mods.summary_en: Moves the existing XFACTION progress entry into character information and adjusts Raccoon City menu presentation without changing progression or items.

mods.title_zh: N&C中文补丁
mods.description_original: Simplified Chinese for N&C's Narcotics: names, recipes, moodles, traits, options and warning speech. Presentation only; no balance changes.
mods.summary_zh: 汉化N&C名称、配方、状态、特性、选项和警告台词。桥接运行当前上游并仅替换已核对文字，不收上游完整实现。
mods.summary_en: Translates N&C names, recipes, moodles, traits, options and warning speech. The bridge runs installed upstream code with audited text substitutions instead of bundling its full implementation.

excluded_files.reason: documentation/history/personal configuration; not a runtime source

mods.title_zh: 猫又岭与EX兼容桥接
mods.title_en: 猫又岭与蘇清背包超级升级兼容
mods.description_original: Build 42.21–42.22 单人独立兼容：保留猫又背包原逻辑，为其他容器完整透传hasRoomFor参数；仅识别已核MaoMao包装链恢复蘇清背包超级升级就绪判定。未知外层仍拒绝。不改容量、物品、材料、付款、配方或存档数据。
mods.summary_zh: 保留猫又背包逻辑，为其他容器透传hasRoomFor参数，并仅对已知MaoMao包装链恢复EX就绪判定；未知包装仍拒绝。
mods.summary_en: Build 42.21–42.22 单人独立兼容：保留猫又背包原逻辑，为其他容器完整透传hasRoomFor参数；仅识别已核MaoMao包装链恢复蘇清背包超级升级就绪判定。未知外层仍拒绝。不改容量、物品、材料、付款、配方或存档数据。

mods.title_zh: 猫猫背包EX升级扩展
mods.title_en: 蘇清的猫猫背包超级升级还原 / SuQing's MaoMao Backpack EX Restoration
mods.description_original: B42.21–42.22 单人。配合超级升级 1.0.0-rc.3 保留猫猫背包原有 EX 容量和还原，按实付材料返还 50%。新增升级使用普通容器升级。 / B42.21–42.22 single-player. With Backpack EX 1.0.0-rc.3, preserves existing MaoMao EX capacity and restoration with a 50% refund of paid materials. New upgrades use ordinary Container Upgrades.
mods.summary_zh: 猫猫背包从原生120升级到EX基础240，沿用EX材料、技能、账本及50%返料；未升级仍为120，停用后的容量行为按原说明。
mods.summary_en: B42.21–42.22 单人。配合超级升级 1.0.0-rc.3 保留猫猫背包原有 EX 容量和还原，按实付材料返还 50%。新增升级使用普通容器升级。 / B42.21–42.22 single-player. With Backpack EX 1.0.0-rc.3, preserves existing MaoMao EX capacity and restoration with a 50% refund of paid materials. New upgrades use ordinary Container Upgrades.

mods.title_zh: PZ Optimization设置汉化
mods.description_original: 简体中文设置和菜单。需要外部 PZ Optimization fad57862 或 f0bca707 与游戏 B42.22.2。| Simplified Chinese settings and menus. Requires external PZ Optimization fad57862 or f0bca707 on B42.22.2.
mods.summary_zh: PZ Optimization fad57862 或 f0bca707 设置汉化。涵盖 577 项名称、导航和部分说明，支持中文搜索。新版 Windows 卸载提醒已翻译。按作者菜单哈希和上下文差异重建。
mods.summary_en: Simplified Chinese settings for PZ Optimization fad57862 or f0bca707. Covers 577 labels, navigation and selected descriptions, with Chinese search. Includes the new Windows uninstall warning. The menu is rebuilt from a pinned author source and a context diff.

mods.description_original: Fixes only True 3D Items zoom/zoomPlus tooltip double translation in the vanilla Mod Options menu. Preserves rendering and saved option values.
mods.summary_zh: 只修复True 3D Items的zoom/zoomPlus提示重复翻译，不改渲染或保存选项。
mods.summary_en: Fixes double translation of True 3D Items zoom/zoomPlus tooltips without changing rendering or saved option values.

mods.title_zh: XFACTION动态特性汉化
mods.description_original: Simplified Chinese presentation for XFACTION Dynamic Traits 0.1.5. No progression, stat or trait identifier changes. Requires a restart.
mods.summary_zh: 面向XFACTION动态特性0.1.3的简体中文显示，不改特性ID、数值或进度。
mods.summary_en: Simplified Chinese presentation for XFACTION Dynamic Traits 0.1.3, without changing trait IDs, values or progression.

mods.title_zh: DAMN原版轮胎维修兼容
mods.description_original: Allows the DAMN tire repair tools, rubber solution and repair strips to repair all nine vanilla tires. Adds a separate crafting recipe and, when Vehicle Repair Overhaul is enabled, an optional repair recipe for its inventory and vehicle menus. Existing items and Workshop files are unchanged. Review compatibility after updates to damnlib, VRO or Project Zomboid.
mods.summary_zh: 让DAMN维修工具可修九种原版轮胎，添加独立配方；VRO存在时提供可选维修入口。
mods.summary_en: Lets DAMN repair tools service all nine vanilla tires with a separate recipe and optional Vehicle Repair Overhaul repair integration.

mods.title_en: Erika Furniture and Optional Debug Generator Fix
mods.description_original: Repairs missing types on known Erika furniture scripts. The item generator guard runs only when DebugMenu is activated; DebugMenu is not a dependency.
mods.summary_zh: 补Erika家具缺失type；只有DebugMenu启用时才运行物品生成器保护，DebugMenu不是硬依赖。
mods.summary_en: Repairs missing types on known Erika furniture. The item-generator guard runs only when DebugMenu is enabled; DebugMenu is not a hard dependency.

mods.description_original: Coalesces automatic inventory UI rebuilds during stationary single-player bulk transfers. Keeps native transfers, interaction, rendering and tooltips. Requires CleanUI. Local reversible performance patch.
mods.summary_zh: 合并单人批量转移的库存刷新。支持 CleanUI 2.10.5 的 42.19 和 42.22 分支，保留已审查旧版的适配。
mods.summary_en: Coalesces automatic inventory UI rebuilds during stationary single-player bulk transfers. Keeps native transfers, interaction, rendering and tooltips. Requires CleanUI. Local reversible performance patch.

mods.title_zh: MFS弹药盒与弹匣显示兼容

mods.description_original: Corrects the M110 ammo-box reference and makes SuPrimitiveEquipment magazine visual helpers validate item definitions and preserve other mods' Clip attachments. Does not replace firearms or change real ammunition loading.
mods.summary_zh: 修正M110弹药盒引用，并让原始装备弹匣显示辅助检查物品定义、保留其他模组Clip挂点；不改真实装弹。
mods.summary_en: Corrects the M110 ammo-box reference and makes Primitive Equipment magazine-visual helpers validate item definitions and preserve other Clip attachments, without changing real ammunition loading.

mods.summary_zh: 让原生灯光快捷键可操作附加手电，保留MFS自动瞄准照明、手持灯和车灯。
mods.summary_en: Lets the native light hotkey reach attached flashlights while preserving MFS aiming lights, handheld lights and vehicle headlights.

mods.title_zh: 原始装备储液提示修复
mods.description_original: Prevents the Primitive Equipment shield tooltip from calling InventoryItem methods on fluid containers. Preserves original shield durability and delegated tooltip rendering. This local PE_Shield.lua overlay is based on the installed SuPrimitiveEquipment 1.0 script; review it after author updates.
mods.summary_zh: 避免原始装备盾牌提示在储液对象上调用物品方法，保留盾牌耐久和原提示渲染；完整PE_Shield覆盖由上游差异重建。
mods.summary_en: Prevents Primitive Equipment shield tooltips from calling item methods on fluid objects while preserving shield durability and delegated rendering. The full PE_Shield overlay is rebuilt from an upstream diff.

mods.title_zh: 批量农耕菜单筛选
mods.description_original: 仅在可耕土、耕地或作物上显示批量农耕菜单，沿用上游动作。支持 B42.21 和 B42.22 单人版。 | Show Batch Farming only on tillable soil, tilled plots or crops. Keeps the upstream actions unchanged. Supports single-player B42.21 and B42.22.
mods.summary_zh: 只在可耕土、耕地或作物上显示批量农耕菜单，原动作不变；不要求喷洒器扩展。
mods.summary_en: Shows the Batch Farming menu only on tillable soil, tilled plots or crops. Upstream actions are unchanged and the sprinkler extension is not required.

mods.title_zh: They Knew沙盒文本修复
mods.description_original: Fixes literal percentage symbols in 23 Chinese sandbox labels. No gameplay changes.
mods.summary_zh: 修复23个中文沙盒标签中的字面百分号，只有文本变化。
mods.summary_en: Fixes literal percent symbols in 23 Chinese sandbox labels; text only.

mods.title_zh: True Music耳机单人兼容
mods.description_original: Updates True Music headphone installation and removal for single-player, including playback cleanup when unplugging headphones, switching off or removing the battery.
mods.summary_zh: 修复42.21单人耳机装卸、拔耳机/关机/取电池的播放清理；普通收音机行为继续委托原实现。
mods.summary_en: Fixes 42.21 single-player headphone attachment/removal and playback cleanup after unplugging, switching off or removing a battery. Ordinary boombox handling continues through the original implementation.

mods.title_zh: 蛋白饮料训练强化
mods.description_original: After drinking Vanilla Foods Expanded protein shakes, multiply normally awarded Strength and Fitness XP by 10. A 500 mL dose grants 3 game hours; partial drinks scale by actual protein-shake volume, stacking duration up to 3 hours. Stacks once with Project Iron 0.6.0 pre-workout (x20 combined at its default setting). Single-player only.
mods.summary_zh: 原蛋白饮料力量与体格经验×10，按摄入量最多3游戏小时；单人适配 Project Iron 0.6.0，默认双增益×20，排除恢复日志经验。
mods.summary_en: Dose-scaled Strength/Fitness XP x10 for up to three game hours. Single-player Project Iron 0.6.0 compatibility stacks both boosts once (x20 by default) and excludes recovery XP.

mods.title_zh: 配方材料输入修复
mods.description_original: Registers Sapph's missing strawberry tag before item and recipe parsing, preventing unrelated items from appearing as strawberry-cheesecake ingredients. Preserves recipe quantities, outputs and milk-fluid inputs. Requires a full restart. Single-player validation scope.
mods.summary_zh: 独立补齐Sapph草莓标签，防止衣服等无关物品进入草莓芝士蛋糕候选，保留原配方与牛奶输入；不改野马补丁。
mods.summary_en: Standalone missing-strawberry-tag registration for Sapph; preserves quantities/fluids and leaves the Mustang guard unchanged.

mods.title_zh: 饵托量产补丁
mods.description_original: 每批使用一整袋沙或泥土，或一份黏土，加任意容器的0.1升水，制作5个原版饵托。支持净水、污水及两者混合水；满袋消耗后保留空袋，水容器保留。沿用原版饵托学习和加料机制。支持 B42.21 和 B42.22 单人版。 | Uses a full sand or dirt bag, or one clay, and 0.1 L of clean or tainted water to make five vanilla chum. Returns an empty bag, keeps the water container and preserves vanilla recipe knowledge. Supports single-player B42.21 and B42.22.
mods.summary_zh: 一整袋沙或泥土，或一份黏土，加任意容器0.1L净水/污水制作5个原版饵托；满袋耗尽返空袋，沿用原版配方知识。
mods.summary_en: Five original chum per full sand/dirt bag or clay, using 0.1 L clean/tainted water from any fluid container; empty bags and vanilla recipe knowledge retained.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的Viewpoint旧版手柄提示修复补丁
mods.title_en: SuQing’s Viewpoint Legacy Prompt Fix Patch
mods.description_original: Restores controller master and prompt-HUD gates for Legacy menu hints. Mouse-only context menus no longer draw A/B prompts. Keeps active-controller and keyboard-resume hints.
mods.summary_zh: 修复旧版 QOL 的右键手柄提示。支持 42.21 和 42.22，在 Legacy 版本不匹配、手柄或提示关闭以及纯鼠标时隐藏 A/B。Lua 补丁。
mods.summary_en: Fixes Legacy QOL right-click controller prompts on 42.21 and 42.22. Suppresses A/B on an unsupported Viewpoint version, disabled controller/HUD, or mouse-only menus. Lua only.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的酿酒技能书50倍补丁
mods.description_original: Only Chinese Cuisine's ChinaBrewing skill books reach a 50x book multiplier when fully read. Partial reading keeps the game's 10-percent steps. Existing reading progress is synchronized on load. No XP, skill level, global XP setting or other skill is changed. Single-player only. Restore the original book multipliers and save before disabling; see README.txt.
mods.summary_zh: 仅将中国菜酿酒书满读倍率设为50；部分阅读保留原版10%阶梯，按真实已读页数同步，不直接加经验或改等级。停用前需恢复原倍率并保存。
mods.summary_en: Sets only Chinese Cuisine brewing-book maxima to 50, retains native 10-percent reading steps and synchronizes actual read pages. No direct XP or level award. Restore original multipliers and save before disabling.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的船舱与房车房间兼容补丁
mods.title_en: SuQing's Boat Cabin and RV Room Compatibility Patch
mods.description_original: 中文：统一检查船舱与3×6房车房间的占用，保留原有房间和物品，在传送前拦截重复占用。仅适配已核对的B42.21–42.22单人源码；不支持联机。上游变化时暂停相关入口。游戏内验收待完成。
mods.summary_zh: 统一避让船舱与3×6房车的38个共用房间，保留已有位置与物品，传送前阻止撞房；仅B42.21单人，游戏内待验。
mods.summary_en: Shares occupancy checks for the 38 boat/3x6 RV slots, retains existing interiors and blocks conflicting entry. B42.21 single-player only; in-game acceptance pending.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的造船就地取材补丁
mods.title_en: SuQing's Boat Crafting Nearby Materials Patch
mods.description_original: 中文：仅让三条造船配方沿用原版就地取材，避免开工前把所有材料搬入人物背包；材料、技能、工作面、成品重量不变。B42.21–42.22单人离线适配，游戏内待验收。上游配方变化时不应用。
mods.summary_zh: 仅三条造船配方就地取材，避免预先全搬进人物背包；材料、工作面和重量保留。
mods.summary_en: Native nearby inputs for three boat recipes; ingredients, surface and weight retained.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的提示框与融合物品栏修复
mods.title_en: 蘇清的提示框与融合物品栏修复 / SuQing's Tooltip and Proximity Selection Fixes
mods.description_original: 修复鼠标跟随文字提示的局部/屏幕坐标竞争，以及融合物品栏刷新时丢失 Shift 连选起点、展开大堆叠时选中行错位的问题。独立客户端补丁，不修改物品或转移机制。 <LINE> Fixes mouse-following text tooltip coordinates and preserves visible-row selections and the Shift anchor during Proximity Inventory refreshes. Standalone client-side patch for the reviewed B42.21–42.22 / CleanUI 2.10.3/2.10.4/2.10.5/2.10.6/2.10.7 combinations.
mods.summary_zh: 修复跟随鼠标的文字提示坐标竞争，并在融合附近物品栏刷新时按实际可见行恢复所选物品与Shift起点，处理大堆叠展开、搜索及Ctrl+A后的选中错位。只针对已审查的CleanUI 2.10.3、2.10.4 和 2.10.5，未知版本不安装选中保持功能；不改物品或转移机制。
mods.summary_en: 修复鼠标跟随文字提示的局部/屏幕坐标竞争，以及融合物品栏刷新时丢失 Shift 连选起点、展开大堆叠时选中行错位的问题。独立客户端补丁，不修改物品或转移机制。 <LINE> Fixes mouse-following text tooltip coordinates and preserves visible-row selections and the Shift anchor during Proximity Inventory refreshes. Standalone client-side patch for the reviewed B42.21–42.22 / CleanUI 2.10.3/2.10.4/2.10.5/2.10.6/2.10.7 combinations.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的野马防护改装修复
mods.description_original: Repair installed Autotsar Mustang protection through the tuning menu. Each action restores 30 condition up to 100. Welding 2, usable welding mask, one matching metal sheet/heavy chain link and 3 blowtorch fuel units are required. Retains parts and tuning data. Single-player only; see README.txt.
mods.summary_zh: 在Autotsar Mustang改装菜单中修理已安装的防撞杠、窗户防护和车轮防护。每次恢复30耐久，最高100；需要焊接2级、可用焊接面罩、金属板或重型链节及喷灯3单位燃料。保留原部件、安装状态及上游改装数据，支持符合原作别名关系的NIKKE Mustang。仅单人。它与旧的Mustang引擎盖配方输入保护是两个不同补丁。
mods.summary_en: Adds repair actions for installed Autotsar Mustang bullbars, window protection and wheel protection through the tuning menu. Each repair restores 30 condition up to 100 and requires Welding level 2, a usable welding mask, sheet metal or a heavy chain link and 3 blowtorch fuel units. Original parts, installation and tuning data remain. Compatible NIKKE Mustang aliases are recognized. Single-player only. Separate from the existing Mustang hood recipe-input guard.

excluded_files.reason: bilingual public documentation copied separately into release candidate

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的世界对象状态保护（修复候选）
mods.description_original: Single-player candidate for reviewed 42.21 resources and the stock 42.22.2 class pair. Skips the animal-only human clothing-hole call and restores a vehicle's missing chunk reference after unique-membership checks. Requires ZombieBuddy 2.3.4 or newer and native Java approval. B42.22.2 game acceptance is pending. See README.txt.
mods.summary_zh: 适用于已审查的42.21类资源和42.22.2原版类组合的单人候选。跳过动物不适用的人类衣物破洞调用，并在唯一成员校验后恢复车辆丢失的区块引用。需要ZombieBuddy至少2.3.4和原生Java批准。42.22.2游戏内验收待完成，详见README.txt。
mods.summary_en: Single-player candidate for reviewed 42.21 resources and the stock 42.22.2 class pair. Skips the animal-only human clothing-hole call and restores a vehicle's missing chunk reference after unique-membership checks. Requires ZombieBuddy 2.3.4 or newer and native Java approval. B42.22.2 game acceptance is pending. See README.txt.

excluded_files.reason: bilingual public documentation copied separately into release candidate

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的好彩香烟菜单修复
mods.title_en: 蘇清的好彩香烟菜单修复 / SuQing's Lucky Strike Menu Fix
mods.description_original: 区分好彩香烟单根与盒装的中文名称，修复 CleanUI 中两种类型混组时的右键菜单报错。B42.21.0 与 B42.22.2 单人 / CleanUI 2.10.4/2.10.5/2.10.6/2.10.7；离线验证，游戏内待验收。 <LINE> Distinguishes the Chinese names of Lucky Strike singles and packs and guards their mixed-stack context menu in CleanUI. B42.21.0 and B42.22.2 SP / CleanUI 2.10.4/2.10.5/2.10.6/2.10.7; offline validation, in-game acceptance pending.
mods.summary_zh: 区分好彩香烟单根与盒装的中文名称，仅保护已审查CleanUI 2.10.4/2.10.5的好彩混组菜单；保留全部成员、吸烟与转移规则。
mods.summary_en: 区分好彩香烟单根与盒装的中文名称，修复 CleanUI 中两种类型混组时的右键菜单报错。B42.21.0 与 B42.22.2 单人 / CleanUI 2.10.4/2.10.5/2.10.6/2.10.7；离线验证，游戏内待验收。 <LINE> Distinguishes the Chinese names of Lucky Strike singles and packs and guards their mixed-stack context menu in CleanUI. B42.21.0 and B42.22.2 SP / CleanUI 2.10.4/2.10.5/2.10.6/2.10.7; offline validation, in-game acceptance pending.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的收藏配方材料标记修复
mods.title_en: 蘇清的收藏配方材料标记修复 / SuQing's Favourite Recipe Materials Fix
mods.description_original: 修复 B42.21.0 与 B42.22.2 单人游戏中自定义模块收藏配方材料缺少绿勾和悬停提示。兼容原版与 CleanUI 详细列表。 <LINE> Restores the green badge and hover hint for favourite recipes in custom modules on B42.21.0 and B42.22.2 single-player. Works with vanilla and CleanUI detailed lists.
mods.summary_zh: 补齐自定义模块收藏配方材料的原有绿勾与绿色悬停提示。
mods.summary_en: 修复 B42.21.0 与 B42.22.2 单人游戏中自定义模块收藏配方材料缺少绿勾和悬停提示。兼容原版与 CleanUI 详细列表。 <LINE> Restores the green badge and hover hint for favourite recipes in custom modules on B42.21.0 and B42.22.2 single-player. Works with vanilla and CleanUI detailed lists.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的 Project Iron 简体中文补丁
mods.description_original: Simplified Chinese menus, equipment, supplements, status text and sandbox options for Project Iron 0.6.0 on Builds 42.21–42.22.
mods.summary_zh: 汉化 Project Iron 0.6.0 的器械、补剂、状态、菜单、沙盒设置及音效名称。
mods.summary_en: Translates equipment, supplements, status text, menus, sandbox options and sound names for Project Iron 0.6.0.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的返鲜餐盒外挂减重修复
mods.description_original: Applies the current content weight reduction while attached to a backpack-bottom slot.
mods.summary_zh: 返鲜餐盒外挂到背包底部时，内容物使用当前容器减重比例。
mods.summary_en: Applies the container reduction to food in an attached lunchbox.

excluded_files.reason: bilingual documentation

mods.title_zh: 撬锁拓展补丁
mods.description_original: 用撬棍撬开防盗门锁、挂锁和车辆锁。车辆操作在 V 键轮盘中。原版和拓展撬锁成功率均为力量等级 × 10%。适用 B42.22.2 单人模式。 <LINE> Pry security doors, padlocks and vehicle locks with a crowbar. Vehicle actions appear in the V radial menu. Both vanilla and expanded crowbar actions use Strength level times 10% as the success chance. Build 42.22.2 single-player.
mods.summary_zh: 扩展撬棍动作，支持防盗门、挂锁与车辆 V 键轮盘。原版与拓展动作均按力量等级 × 10% 判定。
mods.summary_en: Adds crowbar actions for reinforced doors, padlocks and vehicles. Vanilla and expanded crowbar actions use Strength level times 10%.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的现代枪械强化补丁
mods.description_original: Five levels of per-firearm upgrades, maintenance with dry towels or clean cloth, and throwable and energy magazine recipes, and a dedicated MaoMao rifle upgrade. Requires Modern Firearms System and Nekomata Ridge. Build 42.21–42.22 single-player.
mods.summary_zh: 五档单枪强化、用干毛巾或干净布料擦拭维护和三条投掷物配方。需要现代枪械系统。适用 Build 42.21–42.22 单人模式。
mods.summary_en: Five levels of per-firearm upgrades, maintenance with dry towels or clean cloth, and three throwable recipes. Requires Modern Firearms System. Build 42.21–42.22 single-player.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的美沙酮增强
mods.description_original: 美沙酮清除 N&C 过量和未转为依赖的成瘾累计。 Methadone clears N&C overdose and addiction buildup.
mods.summary_zh: 服用美沙酮后清零过量和成瘾累计，保留已有依赖和戒除进度。
mods.summary_en: Methadone clears overdose and addiction buildup while preserving existing dependence and recovery progress.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的 Live Wire × ISA 统一电网
mods.title_en: SuQing's Live Wire × ISA Unified Grid
mods.description_original: Manually connect one ISA power bank to a Live Wire grid for shared solar generation, battery storage and load settlement. Single-player, LiveWire 1.7.2, 2.0.0–2.0.3 or 2.1.0–2.1.6, 2.1.8 or 2.2.0 with ISA 1.2.15–1.2.16. LiveWire 2.1.4–2.1.6, 2.1.8 and 2.2.0 also accepts ISA batteries in LiveWire power banks. LiveWire Extended is unsupported.
mods.summary_zh: 将一台 ISA 电池柜手动接入 Live Wire 电网，共享光伏发电、储电和负载结算。支持单人模式、LiveWire 1.7.2、2.0.0–2.0.3 或 2.1.0–2.1.6、2.1.8 或 2.2.0 与 ISA 1.2.15–1.2.16。LiveWire 2.1.4–2.1.6、2.1.8 和 2.2.0 的电池组也可直接使用 ISA 电池。暂不支持 LiveWire Extended。
mods.summary_en: Manually connect one ISA power bank to a Live Wire grid for shared solar generation, battery storage and load settlement. Single-player, LiveWire 1.7.2, 2.0.0–2.0.3 or 2.1.0–2.1.6, 2.1.8 or 2.2.0 with ISA 1.2.15–1.2.16. LiveWire 2.1.4–2.1.6, 2.1.8 and 2.2.0 also accepts ISA batteries in LiveWire power banks. LiveWire Extended is unsupported.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的 Live Wire × Waterpipes 水路桥接 [单人]
mods.title_en: SuQing's Live Wire and Waterpipes Bridge [SP]
mods.description_original: Share rain collectors, supply opened Useful Barrels, and connect a Live Wire pump to a dedicated Waterpipes line. Single player.
mods.summary_zh: 共用集雨桶，给 Useful Barrels 的开盖桶补水，并将 Live Wire 水泵接入独立的 Waterpipes 管线。仅单人。
mods.summary_en: Share rain collectors, supply opened Useful Barrels, and connect a Live Wire pump to a dedicated Waterpipes line. Single player.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的焊工面罩贴图修复
mods.description_original: 修复 FantasyWorkshop 4.0 导致的焊工面罩红白格纹。 / Restores the welder mask texture path overridden by FantasyWorkshop 4.0.
mods.summary_zh: 恢复 FantasyWorkshop 4.0 覆盖的原版焊工面罩贴图路径。
mods.summary_en: Restores the original welder mask texture path overridden by FantasyWorkshop 4.0.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的 LiveWire 长距离接电 [单人]
mods.description_original: Wire LiveWire equipment directly to its master inverter up to 100 tiles away. Single player.
mods.summary_zh: 让 LiveWire 设备直接接入最远 100 格外的主逆变器。仅单人。
mods.summary_en: Wire LiveWire equipment directly to its master inverter up to 100 tiles away. Single player.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的 CleanUI 容器拖动排序修复
mods.description_original: Fixes container button drag sorting after scrolling the CleanUI 2.10.6/2.10.7 container sidebar.
mods.summary_zh: 修复 CleanUI 2.10.6/2.10.7 容器侧栏滚动后拖动排序位置错位。
mods.summary_en: Fixes container button drag sorting after scrolling the CleanUI 2.10.6/2.10.7 container sidebar.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的皮革晾晒加速
mods.title_en: 蘇清的皮革晾晒加速 / SuQing's Faster Leather Drying
mods.description_original: 小、中、大皮革晾晒架的原有干燥速率乘 2，保留温度和雨雪规则。适用于 B42.22.2 单人档。 <LINE> Doubles the existing drying rate for small, medium and large leather racks while preserving temperature and precipitation rules. For B42.22.2 single-player.
mods.summary_zh: 原版小、中、大皮革晾晒架干燥速率乘 2。
mods.summary_en: 小、中、大皮革晾晒架的原有干燥速率乘 2，保留温度和雨雪规则。适用于 B42.22.2 单人档。 <LINE> Doubles the existing drying rate for small, medium and large leather racks while preserving temperature and precipitation rules. For B42.22.2 single-player.

mods.title_zh: 增强消防斧耐久保险 / Trusty Fire Axe Condition Guard
mods.title_en: 增强消防斧耐久保险 / Trusty Fire Axe Condition Guard
mods.description_original: 将增强消防斧的斧刃耐久限制在游戏实际允许的上限，避免磨刀追逐达不到的锋利度。适用 B42.22.2 单人档。 <LINE> Caps the Trusty Firefighter Axe's blade condition at the game's effective maximum to keep sharpening targets reachable. Build 42.22.2 single-player.
mods.summary_en: 将增强消防斧的斧刃耐久限制在游戏实际允许的上限，避免磨刀追逐达不到的锋利度。适用 B42.22.2 单人档。 <LINE> Caps the Trusty Firefighter Axe's blade condition at the game's effective maximum to keep sharpening targets reachable. Build 42.22.2 single-player.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的现代枪械弹药重量补丁
mods.description_original: Rebalances magazine, ammunition and ammo packaging weights using half of the proposed real-world reference values.
mods.summary_zh: 按现实参考方案的半倍率调整弹匣、弹药和包装负重。
mods.summary_en: Rebalances magazine, ammunition and ammo packaging weights using half of the proposed real-world reference values.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的现代枪械弹药名称修复
mods.description_original: Restores Modern Firearms System's Simplified Chinese names for 12 ammunition families in loose, boxed and cartoned form.
mods.summary_zh: 恢复现代枪械 12 类弹药的散装、盒装和整箱简中名称。
mods.summary_en: Restores Modern Firearms System's Simplified Chinese names for 12 ammunition families in loose, boxed and cartoned form.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的 KNOXWAVE 音量修复
mods.description_original: Repairs sound volume, sound-name lookup and the options page for KNOXWAVE 0.15.34 in B42.22.2 single-player. Requires ZombieBuddy 2.3.4 and Java approval for both mods.
mods.summary_zh: 修复 KNOXWAVE 0.15.34 的原音量、音效名读取和设置页加载。适用于 B42.22.2 单人，需要 ZombieBuddy 2.3.4，并批准两个模组的 Java 文件。
mods.summary_en: Repairs sound volume, sound-name lookup and the options page for KNOXWAVE 0.15.34 in B42.22.2 single-player. Requires ZombieBuddy 2.3.4 and Java approval for both mods.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的 Viewpoint 模拟频率
mods.description_original: Choose 30 Hz, 60 Hz or Off for fixed simulation in Viewpoint 0.1.7. Defaults to 60 Hz. Requires B42.22.2 single-player, ZombieBuddy 2.3.4 and Java approval.
mods.summary_zh: 为 Viewpoint 0.1.7 的固定模拟提供 30 Hz、60 Hz 和关闭三档，默认 60 Hz。适用于 B42.22.2 单人，需要 ZombieBuddy 2.3.4 与 Java 批准。
mods.summary_en: Choose 30 Hz, 60 Hz or Off for fixed simulation in Viewpoint 0.1.7. Defaults to 60 Hz. Requires B42.22.2 single-player, ZombieBuddy 2.3.4 and Java approval.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的现代枪械自动装弹 25 发补丁
mods.description_original: Load up to 25 rounds per cycle when carrying or wearing the automatic reloading device.
mods.summary_zh: 携带或佩戴自动装弹机构时，每轮最多装 25 发。
mods.summary_en: Load up to 25 rounds per cycle when carrying or wearing the automatic reloading device.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的物品详情提示修复
mods.title_en: SuQing's More Item Information Tooltip Fix
mods.description_original: Fixes numeric values causing errors when More Item Information draws an item tooltip.
mods.summary_zh: 修复 More Item Information 绘制物品提示时因数值类型导致的报错。
mods.summary_en: Fixes numeric values causing errors when More Item Information draws an item tooltip.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的 N&C 状态图标兼容修复
mods.title_en: SuQing's N&C Moodles in Lua Fix
mods.description_original: Fixes a texture refresh error when using N&C's Narcotics and Moodles in Lua together.
mods.summary_zh: 修复 N&C 药物模组与 Moodles in Lua 共用时的状态图标贴图刷新报错。
mods.summary_en: Fixes a texture refresh error when using N&C's Narcotics and Moodles in Lua together.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的擦拭修复
mods.description_original: 用干抹布、毛巾或干净布料擦拭近战武器和已卸弹的枪械。近战恢复适用的耐久及锋利度，枪械恢复耐久。适用 B42.22.2 单人模式。 <LINE> SuQing's Wipe Repair restores applicable melee condition and sharpness, or unloaded firearm condition, using dry towels and clean cloth. Build 42.22.2 single-player.
mods.summary_en: 用干抹布、毛巾或干净布料擦拭近战武器和已卸弹的枪械。近战恢复适用的耐久及锋利度，枪械恢复耐久。适用 B42.22.2 单人模式。 <LINE> SuQing's Wipe Repair restores applicable melee condition and sharpness, or unloaded firearm condition, using dry towels and clean cloth. Build 42.22.2 single-player.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的近战强化
mods.description_original: Upgrade a melee weapon three times with nails, a small metal sheet and a ripped sheet. The third upgrade halves its weight. Requires a hammer and ZombieBuddy 2.3.4. Build 42.22.2 single-player.
mods.summary_zh: 用钉子、小金属板和碎布条把近战武器强化三级，第三级使重量减半。需要锤子和 ZombieBuddy 2.3.4。适用 B42.22.2 单人模式。
mods.summary_en: Upgrade a melee weapon three times with nails, a small metal sheet and a ripped sheet. The third upgrade halves its weight. Requires a hammer and ZombieBuddy 2.3.4. Build 42.22.2 single-player.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的便携病毒侦测器
mods.description_original: Mount an MFS virus detector on a digital wristwatch with a screwdriver. Right-click the watch to switch its radar on or off.
mods.summary_zh: 用螺丝刀把 MFS 病毒侦测器装在电子表上。右键手表即可开启或关闭雷达。
mods.summary_en: Mount an MFS virus detector on a digital wristwatch with a screwdriver. Right-click the watch to switch its radar on or off.

mods.title_zh: 蘇清的瞄准增强补丁
mods.description_original: Double focus speed and hold the minimum aim radius through movement, target changes and shots. For Viewpoint 0.1.7 single-player.
mods.summary_zh: 瞄准收圈速度翻倍。持续举枪时可移动收圈，收满后换目标和开枪保持最小瞄准圈。适用于 Viewpoint 0.1.7 单人。
mods.summary_en: Double focus speed and hold the minimum aim radius through movement, target changes and shots. For Viewpoint 0.1.7 single-player.
